feeds.title: Life of Creed
feeds.description: Life of Creed is a lifestyle & travel blog. Follow my adventures in homeschooling, travelling, family, beauty, fashion, product reviews, music reviews, food, and more. On the blog, you will find posts about our adventures around the world, homeschooling, travelling, fashion, food, DIY, product reviews, and whatever is thrown our way.

feeds.title: NOLA Family Magazine
feeds.description: Fleur de Lis Publishing and the first publication, Nola family magazine was started by owner and local mom, Ann Herren, in 2006. New Orleans leading multi-media resource for parents. Locally founded and nationally award-winning. We offer advice, know-how, entertaining and informative articles, and lots more for parents of newborns through those tween years. Subscribe the blog for more updates regarding Mom

feeds.title: Acadiana's Thrifty Mom
feeds.description: Hi all! My name is Rachel Mouton and I am Acadiana Thrifty Mom! I am a wife and mother living in the area of south Louisiana that we love to call Acadiana. This blog is a Lifestyle Blog in the heart of Cajun country.

feeds.title: Fabulous Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tiffany Cruz, long-time parenting lifestyle blogger, Mama to two amazing kids. Fabulous Mom Blog is my way of connecting with and helping other moms. I am all about digging into quality time with board games, random adventures and just plain hanging out.

feeds.title: Always Blabbing
feeds.description: Hi, I am Amber Benoit a working mother of 7 children who loves trying new products and reviewing them. In addition to being a working mother, I am an animal rehabber. So that means we never have a dull moment at my house. I am also a make-up, shoe, fashion, and jewellery junkie and love talking about any and all beauty products. Lots of reviews and giveaways. Occasionally a great deal tossed in the feed too.

feeds.title: Haute Off The Rack
feeds.description: Louisiana based fashion and lifestyle blogger Jennifer Palpallatoc of Haute Off The Rack strives to help women feel confident and beautiful in their clothing by sharing her personal style reviews while also educating her readers on new brands and trends. Her ultimate goal is to maximize her readers outfit options by presenting stylish new looks.

feeds.title: This Ole Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to This Ole Mom! A family-friendly site. A place where we share Delicious Recipes, Ideas for Families, Travel Tips and Adventures, and more! I am a proud mom of one ten years old and two adult children. I live in South, Louisiana, with my husband, our little boy, and one fur baby. I started This Ole Mom blog as a way of documenting all my recipes and crafts I create, as well as all my travel adventures. As you will see on my blog, my love for Cajun and Southern cooking is inspired by my Cajun heritage and my grandmothers and my hometown of New Orleans.

feeds.title: Northshore Parent
feeds.description: A resource for families on the New Orleans Northshore. This blog is about making parenting a little bit easier. Whether it is tips on how to deal with an ear infection or ideas on where to go on your next date night, we are here to help. Your guide to raising kids on the Northshore!

feeds.title: Modern Mommy Madness
feeds.description: My name is Harmony. I am a freelance writer, wife, and mom of three. I made a name for myself writing humour content revolving around alcohol and motherhood. Then, in 2017, I got sober. I'm excited to share my story and chipping away at the stigma that surrounds alcoholism, addiction, and the silent struggles that plague so many modern women - particularly mothers.

feeds.title: Ahalfbakedmom
feeds.description: Motherhood & Lifestyle Blog. I'm Ashley! Wife, mom of 2, foodie, travel enthusiast, and homemaker living in the festive state of Louisiana. I enjoy sharing my motherhood journey and all of the ups and downs it brings.

feeds.title: Candypolooza
feeds.description: Candypolooza is a lifestyle site written from a woman's point of view. Sharing all of the fun a military life, raising a family & enjoying life via food, entertainment, and travel.

feeds.title: Mommallennial
feeds.description: Robin Toups founder of Robin Toups Mommallennial shares next generation parenting tips and tricks through her blog. She is a designer, writer, salesman, carnivore and a proud mother.
